headline: 34 real docs bugs in 12 Python libraries. 3 in 4 flagged findings were real (45 of 60); 30 bugs reproduce a real API error when you run the docs
lead: DocDrift gives Beam an entire Python library (docs + code, up to ~400k tokens) in one call. Beam checks every suspicious doc example against the whole codebase, then writes a script that runs it. Across 12 popular libraries (bugs in 11 of 12 libraries; pydantic-settings had none) it found 34 real docs bugs; 30 crash exactly as the docs are written.
lead_short: Beam read 12 whole Python libraries and ran their docs: 34 real bugs, 30 reproduce.
tiles: crash when you run the docs
label_note: Labels: checked against the source by an AI reviewer, not a human. Recall is measured against the 45 drifts any method found, so it flatters the methods.
end_to_end_tokens_text: ~9.3M tokens (two whole-repo passes plus repro scripts)
non_bug_badges: 2 false + 1 unclear (werkzeug S38, S39 false; S41 unclear)
